record.paper_title: Open Problems in the Topology of Manifolds
record.original_question: For a closed smooth 4-manifold M, define the trisection genus of M to be the minimal genus of the central surface appearing in a trisection of M. Is trisection genus additive under connected sum of closed smooth 4-manifolds?

evidence.quote: Let M be a closed smooth 4-manifold. The "trisection genus" of M is the minimal genus of the central surface appearing in a trisection of M. Question. Is the trisection genus additive under connected sum?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A trisection of a closed smooth 4-manifold $M$ is a decomposition $M = X_1 \cup X_2 \cup X_3$ into three 4-dimensional submanifolds with the following properties: each $X_i$ is diffeomorphic to a 4-dimensional handlebody $\natural^{k_i} (S^1 \times B^3)$ for some integer $k_i \geq 0$; each pairwise intersection $X_i \cap X_j$ ($i \neq j$) is a 3-dimensional handlebody; and the triple intersection $\Sigma = X_1 \cap X_2 \cap X_3$ is a closed orientable surface, called the central surface of the trisection. Define the trisection genus $g(M)$ of $M$ to be the minimum of the genus of $\Sigma$ over all trisections of $M$.

Question: Is the trisection genus additive under connected sum of closed smooth 4-manifolds? That is, for any two closed smooth 4-manifolds $M_1$ and $M_2$, does the equality
$$g(M_1 \# M_2) = g(M_1) + g(M_2)$$
hold?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the trisection genus is additive under connected sum of closed smooth 4-manifolds is reported to remain open. It is known that trisection genus is subadditive under connected sum, and additivity of relative trisection genus would imply additivity of closed trisection genus, which in turn would imply the smooth 4-dimensional Poincaré conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Trisection genus - Manifold Atlas
status_evidence.snippet: Trisection genus is subadditive under connected sum; additivity remains open and would imply the smooth 4D Poincaré conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Additivity of trisection genus under connected sum is an open question.

status_evidence.title: The Trisection Genus of Standard Simply Connected PL 4-Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Connected sums of CP^2, S^2 x S^2, and K3 attain trisection genus equal to second Betti number.
status_evidence.claim: Partial additivity results are known for standard simply connected 4-manifolds.
